name: @lyku/para-bench
description: Differential performance benchmark across the Para ↔ ParaBun boundary. Times the same corpus through the parabun binary (batch + per-spawn) AND the @lyku/para-transpile JS mirror, so compile-speed regressions and the native-vs-mirror multiplier are visible as a trend instead of folklore. Correctness parity lives in @lyku/para-parity; this package only measures. Never published.
